name: Optica GPEF 2026
alert: SETTLE ACCESS FIRST: Optica lists registration as SOLD OUT and non-refundable. No badge, no entry — including the three receptions. Today: ask Industry@optica.org / cpanos-gomez@optica.org for the waitlist or a cancellation, and in parallel try a sponsor guest pass (ams OSRAM, Keysight, Coherent and MKS are Platinum; LIGENTEC has publicly announced attendance and Thomas Hessler is already in the ECOC tracker). If neither works, the speaker list below is still the best target list of the week — many of these people are on the ECOC floor on Wed 23 anyway, and the rest are in Málaga Thu/Fri for bilateral meetings.

Wednesday stays what it was: the ECOC floor is the only window and it closes at 16:00. The Optica Welcome Reception at Candado Beach (19:30) sits cleanly after it — the first GPEF touchpoint and the most informal one. The TechPark tour at 10:30 clashes with the floor and drops out.
rows.notes: Reception entry requires a GPEF badge ⚠
